subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can make comparatives and superlatives in questions.
I can ask and answer opinion questions and give a reason with because.
I can write new game questions with a superlative.

tf.s: The comparative of easy is easier.
tf.why: Yes! y changes to i: easier.

tf.s: The comparative of difficult is difficulter.
"Which is the hottest month in the year?" is correct.
tf.why: Right! hot → the hottest; we double the t.

tf.s: "Are you confidenter than your best friend?" is correct.
tf.why: Confident is long: more confident than.

tf.s: We use because to give a reason for our answer.
tf.why: Yes! It's better to be polite because people like polite people.

tf.s: "Who is the kindest person you know?" uses a superlative.
tf.why: Great! the kindest is a superlative.

tf.s: The superlative of interesting is the interestingest.
tf.why: Interesting is long: the most interesting.

tf.s: It's better to be rude than polite.
tf.why: People like polite people, so it's better to be polite.

tf.s: Long adjectives use more and the most.
tf.why: Yes! more confident, the most interesting.

tf.s: The superlative of hot is the hotest.

boxes.q: Are you ___ than your best friend? (confident)
Which is the ___ month in the year? (hot)
Is fixing toys ___ than doing experiments? (difficult)
What is the ___ book you know? (interesting)
Who is the ___ person you know? (kind)
Is it better to be polite or rude?
o: Polite, because people like polite people.
boxes.why: Polite people make others feel good.

boxes.q: Which do we need for the board game?
boxes.why: Pairs play with a dice and counters.

boxes.q: Which is a question with a comparative?
o: Are you taller than your brother?

mcq.q: Which adjective uses more for the comparative?
mcq.why: Confident is long, so more confident.

mcq.q: Which word do we put before a superlative?
What do we add to give a reason in our answer?
Write a new game question with a superlative.
o: What is the most interesting book you know? Why?
What is more interesting book you know?
What is the interestingest book you know?
What is interesting than book you know?

mcq.q: Answer with a reason: Is it better to be polite or rude?
o: It's better to be polite because people like polite people.
It's better to be rude because people like it.

mcq.q: Find the mistake: "Who is the most kind person you know?"
Why do we say "more difficult" but "easier"?
o: Difficult is a long adjective; easy is short.
mcq.why: Long adjectives use more; short ones add -er.

mcq.q: Which question asks about one thing in a whole group?
o: Which is the hottest month in the year?
mcq.why: The superlative compares one thing with all the others.
